 At Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Abhinav Kalia,
 Kalia, Advocate for
 Mr. Rahul Dhaiya, Advocate for the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the respondent respondents refers to notification dated 01.04.2025 issued under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation of Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in relation to 3 marlas of la land owned by the e petitioner as detailed therein.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation of Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: therein Learned counsel for the respondents on instructions from Mr. Ankur Mohindroo, Assistant O/o PWD, B&R, Yamuna Nagar submits that the proceedings in accordance with the notification dated 01.04.2025 shall be concluded within a period of 4 months from today including the deposit of amount of compensation assessed therein in favour of petitioner.
In view thereof, learned counsel for the petitioner does not press the present petition.
However, in case the responden respondents ts fail to abide by the aforesaid undertaking, entire salary of both the respondents shall remain attached till the needful is done.

05.04.2025 (HARKESH MANUJA)
